Probably the best indie roguelite since Brotato. Maybe takes a bit too much from Isaac but for many I don't think that's a bad thing. Has real potential with polish (more unlocks, maybe a bit more ways to influence a run early, human-readable names for fish and more distinction between them, ie. "Nice, I caught a swordfish", not "Oh, I caught xxyxxoaksdjaaslkj, that's an uncommon apparently"). Worth it on sale for now if you have a couple of hours to get over the initial difficulty floor. I've only made it to the 3rd area so far, but spinning the fishing pole around and clicking to drop it has been probably the most satisfying part, it's not clunky like some other reviews had said.

Make is very early access and should be labeled as such. The game is about 40-50% done. There glitches that were completely run breaking have mostly been fixed but I'm afraid this will never be completed. Picking up guns seems pointless as 80% plus are worse than your base gun. There really isn't much of a progression system. The fishing mechanic is ok but is such a minor portion of the game. It's basically used for money and that's it.

Definitely needs more work. I would enter rooms that had spikes in them and immediately go flying into them before I had time to react because there's no grace period, a bunch of weapons just aren't that great, some upgrades are more like downgrades, and the fishing seems like more of an afterthought than a central mechanic. The basic weapon is unusable if you have another weapon, and weapons lost durability after every room even when I didn't use them. I kept dying to things that didn't feel fair, and the game overall just felt kinda off a lot of the time. With more work I'm sure it could be good, but it just didn't feel very good to me. I'll probably give it a few more tries to see if I can get more into it–and to not waste my money–but as it stands at the time of writing, I don't recommend buying this at full price.

我觉得最大的败笔应该就是像素画风的设定了，这完全可以改成2D卡通，展现出美丽的种有莲花的湖泊！我会这么说，主要的原因在于，像素风格的中文字实在是太难看了！ 一部很有新鲜感的动作肉鸽游戏。 以在湖泊上划船为移动方式，将湖泊划分为多个水域并随机生成景色作为地图，来替代传统意义上的角色跑动和战斗房间。在这方面，它其实还是个传统的动作肉鸽，没有任何不同！ 随机生成，爽射，甚至还能突进劈砍！ 不同的是，它在关卡结束后，会有一条可钓的鱼鱼，通过一种很独特的甩杆方式和QTE机制的拉线方式，成功钓上鱼。 与鱼儿对弈的钓鱼操作性，上钩到钓上来的满足感都达到了！ 关卡的收尾也不会虎头蛇尾，以完工上岸作为结束。 是一款非常成熟且有新颖的传统动作肉鸽游戏，值得一玩。 最后，感谢游戏厂商提供给【网|易】U_U鉴赏家组的游戏牵线。 欢迎关注【网|易】U_U鉴赏家组！

The gameplay is just... kinda okay. The third boss is a bullet hell but you can't dodge or hide behind things, so you just take damage. Not much dodging... and the fishing minigame is just... okay. I don't know. I think I'd rather do other things with my time. Moreover, the discussion forums have had bugs posted for months and the developer never really responded. The achievements only work on every other launch or so, which is just confusing. Some mechanics aren't immediately clear like the existence of red blocks or lack thereof, and... idk. It's just okay. The runs take a long time, there's a ton of backtracking, combat feels repetitive. I never got to any "puzzles" like the trailer suggests, maybe I didn't make it far enough. But I did do several runs, beat the game once, idk.

Not a terrible game, just not very fun mechanically. Obviously inspired heavily by isaac, but with a weird fishing angle that doesn't work. - The gunplay is really bad, shots dont go where you want them to which feels frustrating. - Enemy shots are too fast relative to your speed so damage sometimes feels unavoidable or surprising. - It's hard to judge your melee attack which may easily take away a huge chunk of your health and ruin a long run so you rather not use it. - Fishing is.. odd. The line is very hard to control and almost 2 hours in it's still annoying to deal with. - Items so far try to change things up but it just doesn't work. Your shots always feel weak and uncontrollable. - Bosses are pretty boring. It is a pretty looking game with a good soundtrack, and I appreciate the creativity. I do think it has a lot of potential but it needs a lot more playtesting and design iterations for a sequel. If this had tight combat, interesting items, and actually fun fishing game this would have been a really good game.

Zero progression, zero variety, zero fun. Money is largely useless, and there's no way to meaningfully increase your maximum health, so you're forced to fight bosses with a maximum of 4 HP every time. The fishing mechanic, which is supposed to be a major part of the gameplay, is completely pointless, causing irritation rather than enjoyment and offering a greater chance of losing health than gaining anything worthwhile. When I decided to quickly farm those 10 deaths to unlock another character, it turned out it was slower, dealt less damage, and on top of that only had 3 HP. None of it was permanent, meaning you effectively had just three lives for the entire run. I don't know if this is some kind of joke or if I'm missing something, because I genuinely can't understand how this is supposed to be enjoyable. I'd return this semi-finished product if I still had the time, but this review is all I have left. [h3]3/10[/h3]
